neighbours.label: ' from' or ' by' naming the natural source a substance is made from (obtained from, derived from, produced by), in definitions of materials
fire: Agar is a gelatinous substance extracted from red seaweed.
Aspirin was originally isolated from willow bark.
Rayon is a fibre manufactured from wood pulp.
Penicillin is an antibiotic produced by a common mold.
Basalt is a dark volcanic rock formed from cooled lava.
Lanolin is a wax obtained from the wool of sheep.
Vanillin can be synthesized from lignin by oxidation.
Beeswax is a natural wax secreted by honey bees.
quiet: Agar prices rose from May onward, the report said.
Aspirin was sold from a small shop in Bonn.
Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming in London.
Basalt columns rise by the shore near the old pier.
Lanolin shipments arrived from Australia by boat.
Vanillin sales fell by ten percent last year.
Beeswax candles were lit by the priest at dusk.

short: source of a substance: derived from / produced by
